about.statement: I build web apps the way Daemon rides into battle: fast, precise and with no apology for high standards. Laravel is my home, React is my second language, and the user's experience is the rule everything else answers to.

facts.label: The name
facts.note: Not Yasir, not Yasser. Two s, one i, and every letter pulls its weight.

facts.label: The craft
facts.note: Clean back ends, fast interfaces, and the glue in between.

facts.label: House words
facts.note: Chaos is a ladder, but only for the disciplined.

principles.title: Brutal honesty, kindly delivered
principles.text: Code review is where software gets better. I say what I see, and I expect the same in return.

principles.title: No spaghetti logic
principles.text: Clear layers, clear names, one responsibility per piece. Structure first, speed follows.

principles.title: Loyal, never silent
principles.text: I back the team's decisions, and I challenge the bad ones before they reach production.

principles.title: The user is the law
principles.text: A confused user is a lost kingdom. Performance and clarity are features, not extras.
